27:t_10:32.en:
$$アル$$
「Educational message. Please explain the situation.」

27:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, yes. That's the problem with you, always relying on other people right away. What matters is thinking for yourself and coming up with your own answers.」

27:t_10:34.en:
$$アル$$
「Understood. I will learn from you as well.」

27:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, right away, please show me the results of your learning. Let's give it our all today, too...」

27:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「OK! I look forward to your further growth!」

28:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The unit that the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ reported, believed to be 《$$アマルガム$$》, will land in 《$$アクエリア市$$》 shortly.」

28:t_000:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This route... There's no doubt their target is $$陣代高校$$ in $$第２新東京市$$.」

28:t_000:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Are those people targeting Miss $$千鳥$$ again...?」

28:t_000:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
(He... $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ has been showing a special interest in $$カナメ$$... The Intelligence Division's reports make that clear, too.)

28:t_000:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
(What on earth for? Does he want $$カナメ$$'s power as a 《$$ウィスパード$$》...?)

28:t_000:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If that were so, he should be able to abduct her much more easily...)

28:t_000:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm fine. There's no need to worry, $$マデューカス$$.」

28:t_000:9.en:
$$マデューカス$$
($$アマルガム$$'s executive, $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$, is Captain $$テスタロッサ$$'s own older brother...)

28:t_000:10.en:
$$マデューカス$$
(By what course of events did he come to join $$アマルガム$$...?)

28:t_000:11.en:
$$オットー$$
「But their target is $$第２新東京市$$, and yet they go out of their way through $$アクエリア市$$...」

28:t_000:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It must be a show of force by $$アマルガム$$.」

28:t_000:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「...Damn it, all of humanity on Earth is in danger, and what in the world are they thinking...」

28:t_000:14.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$アマルガム$$ has been cooperating with the 《$$ジェミニス$$》 ever since the 《$$時獄戦役$$》.」

28:t_000:15.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then they should just surrender to the $$新地球皇国$$ already. As usual, they keep pulling incomprehensible stunts.」

28:t_000:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$アマルガム$$... What are they thinking behind actions that look chaotic at first glance...)

28:t_000:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$, please tell me the tactical purpose of pairing me with $n.」

28:t_000:18.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「It was Sergeant $$マオ$$'s recommendation. Ask her directly.」

28:t_000:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「If you want to know, I'll tell you. It's simply so we can supervise the problem children all together.」

28:t_000:20.en:
$n
「Wait a minute. Fine for $$宗介$$, but me too...」

28:t_000:21.en:
$$クルツ$$
「They say the scariest kind of drunk is the one who swears he's not drunk, right?」

28:t_000:23.en:
$$アルト$$
「Give it up, $n. Just being $$宗介$$'s friend is enough to make you a weirdo.」

28:t_000:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If we're going that far, the whole Volunteer Club is a bunch of weirdos.」

28:t_000:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「What are you saying, $$カミーユ$$. The Volunteer Club is $c's squad.」

28:t_000:28.en:
$n
「In short, you're the same kind as us.」

28:t_000:30.en:
$$バナージ$$
「All of us, a gathering of weirdos...」

28:t_000:31.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Who cares. To hell with society's common sense.」

28:t_000:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「From the $$サイデリアル$$'s point of view, we must look like a bunch of crazy people who keep resisting no matter what.」

28:t_000:33.en:
$$甲児$$
「Bring it on. Then I'll gladly welcome the weirdo label.」

28:t_000:34.en:
$n
「Yeah. If they lose to people like that, they'll probably be so shocked they'll leave Earth.」

28:t_000:35.en:
$$マオ$$
「So, did you leave $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ behind again, the ones who said they wanted to join that bunch of weirdos?」

28:t_000:37.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's what you decided. I'm not going to say anything about it.」

28:t_000:38.en:
$$エマ$$
「But realistically, our unit's strength isn't enough either...」

28:t_000:39.en:
$$カツ$$
「That's right. $c is scattered, and everyone from the 《$$エレメント$$》 isn't here, either.」

28:t_000:40.en:
$$ファ$$
「So $$聖天使学園$$ is empty right now...」

28:t_001:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アマタ$$ and the others are acting on their own, on Supreme Commander $$不動$$'s orders.」

28:t_001:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「This is Supreme Commander $$不動$$, who shows up and vanishes whenever he pleases. Of course not.」

28:t_001:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「They don't answer their cell phones when I call, either.」

28:t_001:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Maybe they went back to their own world.」

28:t_001:5.en:
$$クラン$$
「It's true they transferred here from a world beyond time and space, but...」

28:t_001:6.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Is something like that possible?」

28:t_001:7.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$ has power beyond human understanding. It may not be impossible.」

28:t_001:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We never did figure out the relationship between that $$不動ＺＥＮ$$ and the 《$$不動ＧＥＮ#keyword$$》 we know, either.」

28:t_001:9.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「There's no point thinking about people who aren't here. Let's think about intercepting the enemy with the forces we currently have.」

28:t_001:10.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's right, Volunteer Club! If you want to protect your precious school, put some spirit into it!」

28:t_001:13.en:
$$宗介$$
(I'll protect her, no matter what...)

28:t_001:14.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$アマルガム$$ is coming!」

28:t_002:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「A bunch of guys who can't read the room are showing up in droves...!」

28:t_002:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「The ones at the front line are what you'd call bullet shields. The real target is...」

28:t_003:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Unlike this unit, that $$ベヘモス$$ keeps its $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ active at all times.」

28:t_003:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It must be carrying an exceptionally good control AI.」

28:t_003:2.en:
$$アル$$
「I object. This is an operator problem.」

28:t_003:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「At the very least, the AI over there shouldn't be talking back like you do.」

28:t_003:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We're a poor outfit over here, and these guys are swimming in resources! They really can't read the room!」

28:t_003:5.en:
$$マオ$$
「They're an obnoxious bunch to fight. Go wild without holding back!」

28:t_003:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(They're pumping themselves up, but there's no denying we're at a disadvantage...)

28:t_003:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Can we win with what we have now...?)

28:t_004:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Another one of those giant ASes is coming!」

28:t_005:1.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「No way...! We're struggling even now...!」
